bio.text: Nancy Mace is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives serving South Carolina's Lowcountry.
She was born in Fort Bragg and raised in the Lowcountry, and graduated from The Citadel in 1999, the first woman to graduate from its Corps of Cadets.
She earned a master's degree from the University of Georgia in 2004 and, in 2008, founded a company working in technology, public relations and marketing, and commercial real estate.
Before Congress she served in the South Carolina General Assembly.
